state_machine.description: The only retained control state. Each valid request is evaluated and completed in the same invocation; all transitions return to READY.

transitions.action: No database change; clear success indicators, error and status.
If the nonzero ID exists, retain its complete pre-scan record as recipeQueryResult; otherwise set error and status to 16#8001.

If the ID exists, set error and status to 16#8002. Otherwise, if no empty slot exists, set error and status to 16#8003. Otherwise insert recipeIn into the lowest-index empty slot and pulse recipeAdded.
If the nonzero ID is absent, set error and status to 16#8004. Otherwise set only the matching slot's recipeID to zero and pulse recipeDeleted.
If the nonzero ID is absent, set error and status to 16#8005. Otherwise replace the matching slot with recipeIn and pulse recipeModified.

timer_plan.reason: Operations complete in one invocation; no PT durations or timer reset conditions are required.

priorities: There are no safety or reset input ports; validation and database integrity have priority over operational requests.

At the interface boundary, reject simultaneous request rising edges and an add rising edge with recipeIn.recipeID=0 using ValueError before executing or changing retained edge memory. These inputs are outside the valid PLC invocation domain.
Nonzero INT recipe IDs, including negative IDs, are valid. ID zero denotes an empty slot and is absent for query, delete and modify.
For add, duplicate detection precedes the full-database check; successful insertion uses the lowest-index empty slot.
Failed requests never mutate recipe. Each success indicator is a one-invocation pulse; error and status clear on an idle invocation.
The caller owns recipe, initializes it once, and provides exclusive access during each invocation. If the caller changes it between invocations, the caller must preserve uniqueness of nonzero IDs.

For assertions, I.recipe is the caller array sampled before the invocation and O.recipe is the array after it. Other input names denote sampled values and output names denote post-invocation values. rising(x) compares the sampled input with its previous valid invocation, initially FALSE. Record and array REAL comparisons use absolute tolerance 1e-5.

initial_values.recipe: Caller initializes all 10 slots once to {recipeID: 0, ingredientType: 0, ingredientRatio: 0.0, productionTemperature: 0.0}; do not reinitialize per scan.
initial_values.temporary_values: Initialize per invocation: no match, no empty slot, no pending write, success indicators FALSE, error FALSE and status 16#0000.

scan_execution_order.name: Edge sampling
scan_execution_order.action: Sample request inputs, recipeIn and the caller-owned recipe array. Compute rising edges from retained previous inputs. Apply boundary validation before accepting the invocation; for an accepted invocation, update the previous-input memories.

scan_execution_order.name: Safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.action: There is no reset input. Default this invocation's indicators and status to clear. Scan sampled slots 1 through 10 for a matching nonzero ID and the first empty slot. Apply validation and operation priorities, calculate the pending single-slot write or query-result update, and return the control state to READY without an extra scan.

scan_execution_order.name: Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.action: No timer FB instances are required, so this stage has no calls. Any future timer FB must be called here unconditionally, outside CASE and IF.

scan_execution_order.name: Unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.action: Commit at most one pending recipe slot write and assign recipeAdded, recipeDeleted, recipeModified, error and status once from the calculated outcome. Update recipeQueryResult only on successful query; otherwise retain it. Delete writes only recipeID, preserving the sampled remaining fields. All unselected slots remain unchanged.

formal_assertions.formula: G(error -> (O.recipe = I.recipe AND NOT recipeAdded AND NOT recipeDeleted AND NOT recipeModified AND status != 16#0000))

G((NOT rising(addRecipe) AND NOT rising(deleteRecipe) AND NOT rising(modifyRecipe) AND NOT rising(queryRecipe)) -> (O.recipe = I.recipe AND NOT error AND status = 16#0000 AND NOT recipeAdded AND NOT recipeDeleted AND NOT recipeModified))
G(forall i,j in 1..10: (i != j AND O.recipe[i].recipeID != 0 AND O.recipe[j].recipeID != 0) -> O.recipe[i].recipeID != O.recipe[j].recipeID)

G((recipeAdded OR recipeDeleted OR recipeModified) -> (NOT error AND status = 16#0000 AND NOT (recipeAdded AND recipeDeleted) AND NOT (recipeAdded AND recipeModified) AND NOT (recipeDeleted AND recipeModified)))
G((rising(addRecipe) AND exists i in 1..10: I.recipe[i].recipeID = recipeIn.recipeID) -> (error AND status = 16#8002))

G((rising(addRecipe) AND recipeIn.recipeID != 0 AND (forall i in 1..10: I.recipe[i].recipeID != recipeIn.recipeID) AND (exists i in 1..10: I.recipe[i].recipeID = 0)) -> (recipeAdded AND NOT error AND status = 16#0000 AND exists i in 1..10: (I.recipe[i].recipeID = 0 AND (forall j in 1..i-1: I.recipe[j].recipeID != 0) AND O.recipe[i] = recipeIn AND (forall j in 1..10: j != i -> O.recipe[j] = I.recipe[j]))))
G((rising(addRecipe) AND (forall i in 1..10: I.recipe[i].recipeID != recipeIn.recipeID AND I.recipe[i].recipeID != 0)) -> (error AND status = 16#8003))

G((rising(queryRecipe) AND recipeIn.recipeID != 0 AND exists i in 1..10: I.recipe[i].recipeID = recipeIn.recipeID) -> (NOT error AND status = 16#0000 AND exists i in 1..10: (I.recipe[i].recipeID = recipeIn.recipeID AND recipeQueryResult = I.recipe[i])))
G((rising(queryRecipe) AND (recipeIn.recipeID = 0 OR (forall i in 1..10: I.recipe[i].recipeID != recipeIn.recipeID))) -> (error AND status = 16#8001))
G((rising(deleteRecipe) AND (recipeIn.recipeID = 0 OR (forall i in 1..10: I.recipe[i].recipeID != recipeIn.recipeID))) -> (error AND status = 16#8004))
G((rising(modifyRecipe) AND (recipeIn.recipeID = 0 OR (forall i in 1..10: I.recipe[i].recipeID != recipeIn.recipeID))) -> (error AND status = 16#8005))

G((rising(deleteRecipe) AND recipeIn.recipeID != 0 AND exists i in 1..10: I.recipe[i].recipeID = recipeIn.recipeID) -> (recipeDeleted AND NOT error AND status = 16#0000 AND exists i in 1..10: (I.recipe[i].recipeID = recipeIn.recipeID AND O.recipe[i].recipeID = 0 AND (forall j in 1..10: j != i -> O.recipe[j] = I.recipe[j]))))

G((rising(modifyRecipe) AND recipeIn.recipeID != 0 AND exists i in 1..10: I.recipe[i].recipeID = recipeIn.recipeID) -> (recipeModified AND NOT error AND status = 16#0000 AND exists i in 1..10: (I.recipe[i].recipeID = recipeIn.recipeID AND O.recipe[i] = recipeIn AND (forall j in 1..10: j != i -> O.recipe[j] = I.recipe[j]))))
